data.title: Reasoning Model
data.tagline: A class of language models that uses additional internal reasoning computation for harder problems
data.learningOutcome: You can use a reasoning model for a multi-step task and check its conclusion against logs, tool results, or the actual outcome.
data.description: A signup page says the submission succeeded, but the record disappears after refresh. A reasoning model may help an Agent investigate the prompt, request, and save result step by step; it does not automatically see logs or guarantee the right cause, so check the real outcome.

learning.assumes: You have seen AI take longer on a complex task, or heard of reasoning models.
learning.outcome: You can use a reasoning model for a multi-step task and check its conclusion against logs, tool results, or the actual outcome.

distinctions.label: Temperature
distinctions.explanation: Temperature adjusts sampling randomness for APIs that support it; a reasoning model uses additional computation on complex tasks. They are different controls.

distinctions.label: Showing a thought process
distinctions.explanation: Explanatory text on screen is not the model's real internal reasoning. Raw reasoning tokens are generally not shown as private thought text; a checkable conclusion, evidence, and steps are more useful.

explanation.title: Useful for multi-step tasks
explanation.text: Additional reasoning compute can help break down a difficult task or plan checks. It can also add token use and waiting; effects vary by model and task.

explanation.title: Ask for checkable evidence
explanation.text: Look at the investigation order, tool results, or test records. A detailed explanation does not replace the actual request and saved result.

data.boundary: Reasoning models can still be wrong. Raw reasoning tokens generally are not shown as full private thought text; acceptance should rely on externally checkable results.

lessonPractice.title: A signup page says the submission succeeded, but the record is missing after refresh. After the Agent changes the code, what best confirms the issue is fixed?

options.label: Submit again, refresh, and confirm the request succeeds and the record is still available
options.feedback: Correct. The real request result and the record after refresh check whether the save path completed; the model's explanation cannot replace them.

options.label: Accept the Agent's root-cause explanation and check whether it edited related code
options.feedback: An explanation and code change show an attempt, but do not prove the request succeeded or that saved data can be read.

options.label: Ask the Agent to reveal longer internal reasoning to confirm its analysis was complete
options.feedback: Raw internal reasoning is not reliable acceptance evidence; inspect the actual request result and the record after refresh.

data.agentPrompt: This signup issue involves submission and reading the result after refresh. First give me the investigation order, then use the actual request result and saved record to find the cause. After the change, submit again and refresh; say it is fixed only if the record remains. Show the evidence for your conclusion, not internal reasoning.
